intent: Create a memory card matching game with 16 cards, a move counter and a restart button.

spec.goal: Build a memory card matching game that the user can play and restart.
spec.deliverable: A working memory card matching game app with a 16-card board, a move counter and a restart button.
constraints: The game shows a move counter.
The game has a restart button.
done_criteria: The game displays 16 cards that can be flipped to find matching pairs.
The move counter is visible and increases as the player makes moves.
Pressing the restart button resets the board and sets the move counter back to zero.
spec.summary: You want a memory card matching game with 16 cards, a move counter and a restart button.
